verses.1: The sins of Judah are written in bronze characters on the gates of Zion. They remain engraved in their hearts and minds, as well as on the doors of their shrines.
verses.2: In memory of their children, their sacrifices, and their locations on the trees of the sun, on the heights above.
verses.3: May your army be defeated in the field! May all your possessions be lost. May you be destroyed by sin, throughout all your borders.
verses.4: And you shall reign over those who are under your rule. You will serve your enemies in a land that you do not know. For they will be destroyed by fire forever.
verses.5: Thus said Jehovah: “Let there be a curse upon the man who trusts in his own strength, and who plants his seed in the ground. From Jehovah, let there be a warning for him.”
verses.6: And it will be like a storm in the wilderness; no good will come from it. The wicked will dwell in the desert of Melchah, and they will not be able to settle there.
verses.7: Blessed be the branch that is assured by Jehovah; and let Jehovah be assured by it.
verses.8: And it shall be like a tree that grows on water and in swamps. Its roots will spread out, and it won’t be affected by heat. There will be clouds over it during the dry season, but it won’t suffer any harm from those conditions.
verses.9: The heart is attached to everything, and who can truly know us?
verses.10: I, Jehovah, examine the hearts of all people, and I will show each person their true nature, according to what they have done.
verses.11: He reads the Torah, but he doesn’t grow up. He makes forty years, yet he still isn’t wise. In the middle of his days, he will leave us. And later on, he will become a fool.
verses.12: It is a great honor to be here from our holy place.
verses.13: From the land of Israel, the LORD says: All those who leave you will be punished. Their names will be written down in the book of records, because they have left the land of the living God.
verses.14: May the LORD heal me, and may He save me from my ailments. For your words are true.
verses.15: Look, these people say to me, “What is the will of Jehovah? Will it come now?”
verses.16: And I will not turn aside from your ways. One day, when we are together, I will not be against you. You know that wherever my lips are, your face will be there.
verses.17: May there be no need for me to ask for your protection on a bad day.
verses.18: May their pursuers be destroyed! I will bring them a bad and terrible day. May they be broken apart!
verses.19: Thus said Jehovah: “Let them go forth and stand at the gates of the people, those who come in by those gates. They are the kings of Judah, and they will go out through all the gates of Jerusalem.”
verses.20: And you said to them, “Let them hear the words of the LORD, the king of Judah and all of Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem who come into these gates.”
verses.21: Thus said the LORD: “Keep these things in your hearts. Do not carry anything on the Day of Rest. Bring them into the gates of Jerusalem.”
verses.22: And do not carry out any work on that day. Do not do any kind of labor or activity. Keep that day holy, just as your ancestors were commanded to do.
verses.23: And they did not hear, nor did they pay attention. They closed their ears and refused to listen. They wanted nothing to do with it.
verses.24: And if they hear the voice of the LORD, then let them bring offerings into the gates of this city on the day of Pentecost. Let them sanctify that day, and do not perform any other rituals or ceremonies on that day.
verses.25: And kings and officials came into the streets of this city. They sat on David’s throne, riding in chariots and wagons. Their servants were also Jews; the people of Jerusalem became a city that would reign forever.
verses.26: And they came from the cities of Judah and from the surrounding areas of Jerusalem. They also came from the land of Benjamin, from the lowlands, from the mountains, and from the hills. They brought with them offerings of worship, sacrifices, offerings for sin, and gifts for building God’s house.
verses.27: And if you do not listen to me and do not sanctify the Day of Rest, then I will set fire to its gates on the Day of Rest. I will also burn down the streets of Jerusalem. Then they will not be able to be extinguished.
